findings_qualitative.value: EF emits mainly from compact ridge and hot core-SW, peaking at same positions as MF; ET is absent from the compact ridge; HCOOH does not coincide with EF

evidence.quote: The gas emission of MF is very similar to that of EF, while ET mainly originates from the hot core-SW but not from the compact ridge.

claims.hypothesis: Does EF form via gas-phase reactions involving HCOOH and NH3?
claims.experiment: Compared HCOOH abundance, HCOOH and NH3 spatial distribution with EF and with Taquet16 requirements
claims.result: HCOOH abundance (1.3±0.4)e-9 far below model needs; no spatial coincidence of HCOOH or NH3 with EF
claims.finding: Gas-phase routes cannot produce the observed EF

evidence.quote: the molecular abundances and spatial distributions of HCOOH and NH3 indicate that the proposed gas-phase routes are not able to produce the observed EF abundance in Orion KL

claims.hypothesis: Is EF formed on grain surfaces from MF-derived radicals?
claims.experiment: Compared EF abundance, MF/EF ratio, T_rot and spatial co-peaking with Garrod08 model
claims.result: EF abundance (2-3)e-9 and MF/EF ratios agree with model; EF and MF share peaks
claims.finding: EF likely formed on grains by CH3 addition to CH2OCHO and then evaporated

evidence.quote: these results suggest that EF is likely formed on grains by addition of CH$_{3}$ to functional-group radicals (CH$_{2}$OCHO) derived from CH$_{3}$OCHO

why_this_data.value: Interferometric high-resolution multi-transition data needed to get spatial distribution and source-averaged column densities

evidence.quote: To better constrain the formation of this species, interferometric observations at high angular resolution and good sensitivity are needed.
So this gas-phase reaction can not produce enough abundance of EF.

limitations_admitted.value: Some EF lines are blended or affected by poor baseline subtraction and CDMS/JPL discrepancies; strong MF lines overestimated possibly by opacity and filtering

evidence.quote: A possible explanation is a poor baseline subtraction at these spectral ranges, since Orion is a line-rich source, and it is difficult to find free-line channels
